verdict.rationale: Aider is fundamentally a terminal-based chat tool, not an IDE-embedded panel, but its --watch-files/'watch mode' lets developers leave AI instructions as comments in their favorite IDE/editor which Aider then applies, and community reports confirm this workflow works alongside a normal editor. There is no evidence of a native VS Code/JetBrains extension or an in-IDE chat UI comparable to embedded copilots. Missing for 10: dedicated first-party IDE extension/plugin, an embedded chat panel inside the IDE UI (not just file-watching triggers), and independent hands-on validation of IDE-embedded chat specifically.
